/.title: Oil Find：文件、应用、剪贴板，一处搜索
/.description: 按 ⌘Space 打开 macOS 搜索面板。搜索文件、应用与本地 Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy 对话，选择性保存剪贴板文本、链接、图片和本地文件路径引用，离线计算和单位换算；网页搜索只在你提交时打开。免费版采用 MIT 许可证并始终免费；Pro 是独立的闭源付费扩展。

zh.q: 和 Spotlight 有什么不同
zh.a: Spotlight 同时搜索文件内容、应用和网页。Oil Find 使用自己的文件名索引，支持拼音首字母、通配符、正则和实时更新；同一面板还能搜索本地 Claude Code、Codex 和 WorkBuddy 对话。
和 Windows 上的 Everything 思路一样：给磁盘上的文件名建一份索引，输入即出结果。Everything 只有 Windows 版，Oil Find 是为 Mac 写的原生应用。

en.a: Spotlight searches file contents, apps and the web. Oil Find uses its own file-name index, with pinyin initials, wildcards, regular expressions and live updates. The same panel also searches local Claude Code, Codex and WorkBuddy conversations.
It works like Everything on Windows: an index of every file name on your disk, with results as you type. Everything is Windows-only; Oil Find is a native Mac app.

privacy.zh: 文件引擎只读取名称、大小和修改时间。启用 AI 会话搜索后，会读取所选来源保存在本机的对话标题与正文，并在本机建立独立索引，不会上传。Pro 的图片与文档内容处理也在本机完成。剪贴板记录默认关闭，启用后保存获准的文本、链接、粘贴板图片和本地文件/文件夹路径引用，在本机加密并由钥匙串保护；图片保留原始编码内容，不自动做 OCR 或联网，可主动在截图工具中识字，单图最多 16 MiB、6400 万像素，历史总量最多 32 MiB；Finder 复制图片文件仍只保存路径，不读取正文。敏感、临时、自动生成标记、来源应用排除及尚未生成的文件承诺限制继续生效。汇率来源只接收固定的公开币种列表，不发送金额或完整查询。网页搜索只在你选择并提交后打开；fork 构建不连接上游官方应用更新服务。独立截图历史和素材使用派生密钥加密；可编辑历史保留打码前原图，导出仅含最终像素。截图历史默认 7 天、100 张、256 MiB，可关闭。屏幕录制只在主动截图时请求，钉图文退出后不恢复。
privacy.en: The file engine reads names, sizes and modification dates only. When AI conversation search is enabled, selected sources’ locally saved titles and body text are read into a separate local index and never uploaded. Pro image and document processing also stays on your Mac. Clipboard history is off by default; when enabled, it saves eligible text, links, clipboard images and path references to local files and folders, encrypted locally and protected with Keychain. Images retain their original encoded bytes; they are not automatically OCR-processed or sent over the network; local OCR is available when explicitly requested, and each image is limited to 16 MiB and 64 megapixels within a 32 MiB history cap. Finder copies of image files remain path references and are not read. File references store paths without backing up files or reading contents. Concealed, transient and autogenerated markers, source app exclusions and ungenerated file-promise exclusions still apply. Currency requests contain only a fixed list of public currency pairs, never the amount or full query. Web search opens only after you choose and submit; fork builds do not connect to the upstream official app-update service. Independent screenshot history and materials are encrypted with derived keys. Editable history retains originals before redaction; exports contain flattened pixels only. Defaults are 7 days, 100 images and 256 MiB, and recording can be disabled. Screen Recording is requested only on capture; pins are not restored after exit.
